narrative: The market is currently in a risk-on regime driven by a resurgence in AI sector optimism, fueled by strong earnings from CoreWeave and high demand for the upcoming Anthropic IPO. Despite this equity rally, macroeconomic headwinds persist as bond market volatility keeps 10-year yields near 5% and Fed rate hike expectations surge. Investors are balancing robust US economic growth against the risks of higher interest rates and potential regulatory scrutiny on AI chip exports. Geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding the Iran war and US-China trade relations, continue to influence sentiment. Overall, the market is prioritizing AI growth momentum while remaining cautious of the tightening monetary policy environment.

Nasdaq.why: The index is rallying and outperforming due to renewed momentum and strong earnings in AI-related names like CoreWeave and Nvidia.

S&P 500.why: The index has recovered recent losses and is holding near session highs, supported by broad-based gains and positive earnings momentum.

Gold.why: Prices are declining and trading below $4,000 per ounce.

Oil.why: Views are conflicting; while some anchors note price declines as a positive for equities, others highlight gains driven by geopolitical risks in the Middle East.
